meals.title: Braaied Pork Chops with Butternut and Cucumber-Yoghurt Salad
meals.why: PnP Pork Braai Chops are on special at R69.99, and butternut is only R14.99/kg and in season in Cape Town's cooler months.
method: Cut the butternut into thick wedges, toss with oil, salt and pepper, and wrap in foil parcels. Put them on the coals for 30-35 minutes until soft.
Season the pork chops with braai spice, salt and a little oil, and leave them at room temperature while the fire settles.
Mix the yoghurt with grated garlic, lemon juice, chopped herbs and diced cucumber. Season and chill.
Braai the chops over medium coals for 5-6 minutes a side until cooked through and the fat is crisp.
Rest the chops for 5 minutes, then serve with the butternut and the cucumber-yoghurt salad.

meals.title: Creamy Butternut and Tomato Curry with Rice
meals.why: A meat-free dinner built on R14.99/kg butternut, with pantry specials (tomatoes, rice, masala) doing most of the work.
also_need: extra curry powder or garam masala
method: Fry a chopped onion in oil until soft, then add garlic, ginger and the Rajah masala (plus extra curry powder if you like more heat). Cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and about 600g of cubed butternut, with a splash of water. Simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes until the butternut is tender.
Add chickpeas now if using. Stir in the cooking cream and simmer for 5 minutes. Season to taste.
Cook the rice according to the packet while the curry simmers.
Serve the curry over the rice, topped with coriander.

meals.title: 20-Minute Tuna and Tomato Pasta
meals.why: Two small Woolworths specials (pasta R18.33, shredded tuna R25) plus canned tomatoes make a dinner for about R60.

uses.item: Shredded tuna in oil or brine

method: Boil the pasta in well-salted water according to the packet.
Meanwhile, soften sliced garlic and chilli flakes in olive oil for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 8-10 minutes until thickened.
Stir in the drained shredded tuna and warm it through. Add a squeeze of lemon and season.
Toss with the drained pasta, adding a splash of pasta water if it looks dry. Top with herbs and Parmesan.

meals.title: Slow-Braised Beef Short Ribs in Tomato Sauce
meals.why: Short ribs are on special at PnP, and a long, slow braise turns them tender. The pantry specials (tomatoes, paste, carrots, rice) round out the meal.
method: Heat the oven to 160°C. Season the ribs well and brown them in a hot, oven-proof pot with oil. Set aside.
In the same pot, soften sliced onion and garlic. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, a cup of stock or water (and wine if using), bay leaf, thyme and chunky carrots. Return the ribs to the pot.
Cover and braise for 2.5-3 hours, until the meat is falling off the bone.
Cook the rice and serve the ribs and sauce over it.

meals.title: Classic Cottage Pie
meals.why: Lean beef mince is R109.99/kg at Checkers, and a 2kg bag of potatoes plus carrots and tomato paste stretch it into a family-sized pie.
method: Peel and boil about 1kg of potatoes until soft. Mash with milk, butter, salt and pepper.
Brown the mince in a large pan with chopped onion, garlic and grated carrot. Stir in the tomato paste and a spoonful of flour.
Add stock and Worcestershire sauce and simmer for 15 minutes until thick. Season.
Spoon the mince into an oven dish, top with the mash, rough it up with a fork and add cheese if using.
Bake at 190°C for 25-30 minutes until golden on top.

meals.title: Sheet-Pan Chicken with Potatoes and Carrots
meals.why: SPAR's 4kg frozen chicken pack works out cheap per portion, and the potatoes and carrots are both on special, so it makes a low-effort tray bake.

uses.item: SPAR Frozen Chicken Mixed Portions with a Brine Based Mixture (4kg)

also_need: salt (go light, as the chicken is brined)
method: Thaw the chicken portions in the fridge the day before, then pat them very dry. Heat the oven to 200°C.
Cut the potatoes into chunks and the carrots into sticks. Toss with oil, herbs and pepper on a large baking tray.
Rub the chicken with oil, paprika, garlic powder and pepper. Nestle it among the vegetables, skin side up.
Roast for 45-55 minutes, turning the vegetables once, until the chicken juices run clear and the skin is crisp.
Squeeze lemon over the tray and serve. Freeze any leftover raw portions for another meal.
